notes_for_editor: Thin and not independent: the design, 1934 date and 1974 gone date come from the two lookout pages (same site family) and the county list; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list only confirms gone. Two web searches found no other record of this tower. Caution: a firelookout.com page for Arctic Point (Payette NF, Big Creek) uses nearly the same wording (72' steel tower with a log cabin, built 1934), so the Cottontail design line may have been copied from it. Check against a Payette NF source before publishing. Record coordinates (45.3822, -115.74643) were not checked against 9 miles NNW of Warren or T24N R6E, 32. The record has no events; the 1934 and 1974 events are added from these pages.
